basis: FAM-BLAZER-BUILD-004 / BLAZER-PREP: unsigned build-only recipe for blazer (Pixel 10 Pro) from checked-in pinned sources only. It binds no host: the operator supplies the host label, isolated work tree, lock, download and receipt paths, Node and make jobs at run time, and scripts/blazer-build-only.py admits them. Preparation (download, vendor, lunch) never compiles, signs, publishes or flashes and never runs in the production source tree. Nothing here was downloaded, generated, compiled, signed or run on any host or phone.

integration.basis: Compile needs the Rose integration: the newest reconcile receipt in the operator's --integration-dir must be a blazer-labelled receipt from this checkout's trusted patcher that still matches the tree, and must bind to --inputs-receipt (scripts/blazer_integration.py admit over os/build-only/blazer-reconcile.json): the admitted build label and recipe, the installed APK bytes, Launcher3, the routed Updater and the policy pins.

capacity.basis: available - bound >= reserve on the filesystem each stage writes. Preparation stages use the explicit proposal bounds in preparation.*.boundBytes. compile (outside preparation) still needs a measured compileAllowanceBytes, which is null.

preparation.boundsBasis: Proposed upper bounds for review, not measurements: no Blazer preparation has run. A stage refuses before it starts when available minus its bound is below capacity.reserveBytes, stops at its byte or time bound, and records what it consumed.

download.boundBasis: 8 GiB is an unverified proposal for the Pro factory ZIP: no Pro archive size is recorded, and the historical Frankel factory ZIP size is not Pro evidence. An archive above the bound stops and is removed, never kept.

vendor.collisionBasis: vendor/google_devices/{device} is generate-all's output; vendor/adevtool/dl/unpacked/{device}-{BUILD_ID} is adevtool's unpack cache as recorded in os/release-pipeline/cuttlefish-alpha.json (src/config/paths.ts UNPACKED_IMAGES_DIR, INFRA-ALPHA-090 frankel-CP3A.261005.005); historical evidence, both must be absent and are never deleted

limits.basis: Not a filesystem quota: every sampleSeconds the stage's watched paths are measured against its boundBytes and the filesystem's available bytes against capacity.reserveBytes, and an overrun or timeout stops the stage's process group (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after killGraceSeconds). Writes between samples can overshoot. An enforced quota (project quota, loop device, cgroup io) and containment of descendants that start their own session need host-side authority and are not provided here.

preparation.totalBasis: 4.5 hours: download 3600 + vendor 10800 + lunch 1800 seconds, excluding the isolated source construction, whose byte and time cost is unknown and separately scoped. The 144 GiB of bounds plus the 300 GiB reserve also exclude that source copy.
